fields.name: asin
fields.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN), single ASIN only, max length 1000

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Amazon domain ID. Options: 1 (United States), 2 (United Kingdom), 3 (Germany), 4 (France), 5 (Japan), 6 (Canada), 8 (Italy), 9 (Spain), 10 (India), 11 (Mexico), 12 (Brazil)

fields.name: days
fields.description: Limit historical data to this many days, default 90, max 365

fields.name: showPrice
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the lowest new price curve in the market

fields.name: showPriceList
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the list/strikethrough price curve

fields.name: showPriceDeal
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the deal/flash sale price curve

fields.name: showPricePrime
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the Prime-exclusive new price curve

fields.name: showPriceFba
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the third-party FBA new price curve

fields.name: showPriceFbm
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the third-party FBM new price curve

fields.name: showPriceCoupon
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the coupon-applied Buy Box price curve

fields.name: showBsrMain
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the main category BSR curve

fields.name: showSellerCount
fields.description: Set to 1 to return the seller count curve
